doc.name: QR Suisse documentation
doc.instructions: Read-only documentation of QR Suisse, a Swiss dynamic QR code generator, and of its REST API v1. Use qr_suisse_search_docs to find a page, then qr_suisse_get_page to read it. This server has no access to any account: to act on QR codes, use the QR Suisse API with an API key (see the auth-md page).

tools.name: qr_suisse_search_docs
tools.title: Search the QR Suisse documentation
tools.description: Keyword search in the QR Suisse documentation (English): overview (llms.txt), instructions for agents, API authentication, pricing and one page per operation of the QR Suisse REST API v1. Returns up to 5 pages, best match first.

query.description: Keywords in English, for example "create dynamic QR code" or "rate limit".

page.description: Page identifier, to pass to qr_suisse_get_page.

excerpt.description: Passage of the page around the first matching term.

tools.name: qr_suisse_get_page
tools.title: Read a QR Suisse documentation page
tools.description: Returns the full Markdown text of one page of the QR Suisse documentation (English), from a closed list: llms-txt, agents-md, auth-md, pricing-md, or api/<operationId> for an operation of the QR Suisse REST API v1.

page.description: Page identifier, as returned by qr_suisse_search_docs.
